description: This Java class defines a rule engine node for deleting attributes from a message originator in the Thingsboard platform. It processes configuration, handles messages, and invokes attribute deletion with optional notifications.

classes.name: TbMsgDeleteAttributesNode
classes.description: A rule node for deleting specified attributes from a message originator, with optional notification and callback handling.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration and extracts keys to delete.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, processes keys, and triggers attribute deletion requests.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Determines the attribute scope based on message metadata or default configuration.

methods.name: checkNotifyDevice
methods.description: Checks whether to notify the device based on scope and configuration.
